component.name: ReDUB
component.summary: Play Midnight Club 3 Remix through static recompilation

description.p: ReDUB is a native recompilation of the Xbox version of Midnight Club 3: DUB Edition Remix. Supply your own legally obtained, extracted game files. No game data is included.
This Linux build supports gamepads, configurable graphics, and MPRIS media controls.
Linux AppImage release with bundled dependencies and persistent user settings.
